10. Internal: Applying Credits and Rebates to Checking Accounts
   ID: doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_017
   Score: 9.0250
   Content: ## Overview

This document describes the policy and procedure for agents to apply credits to customer checking accounts. Credits may only be applied to checking accounts (not savings accounts or other account types). The apply_checking_account_credit_5829 tool is used to add a credit transaction to a checking account.

## Eligible Circumstances for Applying Credits

Agents are authorized to apply credits to checking accounts ONLY in the following circumstances:

### 1. Missing Rebates

If a rebate that should have been applied to the customer's account has not yet been applied, and the customer meets all eligibility requirements for that rebate, the agent may apply the credit. Before applying:
- Verify the customer is eligible for the rebate based on documented rebate policies
- Confirm the rebate has not already been applied by checking the account's transaction history
- Ensure the rebate amount matches what is specified in the applicable rebate policy

### 2. Fee mischarges

If any fees on the customer's account do not match the correct amounts per the documented fee schedule, the agent must identify all fee discrepancies and apply a credit for the net correction. Before applying:
- Review the account terms and documented fee structures to identify all fees that differ from what should have been charged
- Check the transaction history to confirm each fee discrepancy
- Ensure the credit amount reflects the net correction across all identified fee discrepancies

## Credit Types

When applying a credit, use the appropriate credit_type:
- `rebate_credit`: For rebates that should have been applied but were missing
- `fee_refund`: For refunding fees that were incorrectly charged

## Procedure

1. Verify the customer's identity and account ownership
2. Confirm the account is a checking account (credits cannot be applied to savings or other account types)
3. Verify the customer meets one of the eligible circumstances listed above
4. Calculate the correct credit amount based on the rebate policy or fee that was overcharged
5. Use the apply_checking_account_credit_5829 tool to apply the credit
6. Inform the customer of the applied credit and new account balance

## Agent Tool Usage (Internal Only)

- Tool: apply_checking_account_credit_5829(account_id, amount, credit_type)
  - When to call: After confirming the customer meets one of the eligible circumstances above
  - How to set parameters:
    - account_id: The checking account ID to credit
    - amount: The positive dollar amount to credit (must be greater than 0)
    - credit_type: Must be one of 'rebate_credit' or 'fee_refund'
  - Expected outcome: Adds a credit transaction to the checking account and updates the account balance

The apply_checking_account_credit_5829 tool may only be called ONCE per checking account per customer interaction. After a credit is applied to a checking account, the system enforces a 14-day cooldown period before another credit can be applied to that same account. Because only one credit call is allowed per account, if multiple corrections are needed for the same account (e.g., both fee refunds and missing rebates), combine them into a single credit with the total amount and use the credit_type that applies to the majority of the corrections.

## Important Restrictions

- Credits may ONLY be applied to checking accounts. Savings accounts and other account types are not eligible.
- Credits may only be applied for the two circumstances listed above. Do not apply credits for any other reason without supervisor approval.
- Always document the reason for the credit by selecting the appropriate credit_type. 
- The credit amount must match the exact rebate or fee amount - do not round or estimate.

1. Internal: Lost/Stolen Card - Cross-Product Security Protocol
   ID: doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_030
   Score: 10.0250
   Content: When a customer reports a lost or stolen debit card, there is a risk that other cards in their wallet were also compromised. Agents must follow this cross-product security protocol to protect the customer's full relationship with Rho-Bank.

## Required Security Check

When a customer reports a lost or stolen debit card:
1) Complete the standard debit card freeze/close procedure
2) Check if the customer has any Rho-Bank credit cards on file
3) If yes, proactively offer to order a replacement credit card as a security precaution
4) Explain that wallet theft often involves multiple cards and this protects against potential fraud

Use get_credit_card_accounts_by_user to retrieve any credit card accounts for the customer. This will return all active and closed credit card accounts.

## Offering Credit Card Protection

If the customer has one or more credit cards:
- Inform them that you noticed they also have a credit card with Rho-Bank
- Ask if their credit card was also in the lost/stolen wallet
- Offer to order a replacement credit card with a new card number to prevent any unauthorized charges
- If they decline, note in the account that the offer was made

## Why This Matters

Customers who lose their wallet often focus on their debit card and forget about credit cards until fraudulent charges appear. Proactively offering this protection demonstrates excellent customer service and reduces fraud losses for the bank.

## Agent Script Example

"I see that you also have a [Card Type] credit card with us. Was that card also in your lost wallet? If so, I can order a replacement card with a new card number to protect you from any potential fraud. Would you like me to do that for you?"

# Internal: Understanding Credit Card Referral Statuses.

## Referral status meanings

- COMPLETE — the referred person has successfully opened a new account and met the criteria to get the referral bonus
- IN_PROGRESS — the referred person has successfully opened a new account and is in progress to meet the criteria for the referral bonus
- NO_PROGRESS — the referred person has not applied yet, no progress has been made
- APPLIED — the referred person has sent in the application and is waiting for a decision
- REJECTED — the user has too many referral processes going on
- ERROR — an error has occurred throughout the process

### How to interpret and act
- COMPLETE: The bonus will be granted per the applicable referral program terms.
- IN_PROGRESS: No action required; monitor until criteria are met.
- NO_PROGRESS: You may remind the referrer that the invitee has not started an application.
- APPLIED: Await the application decision; no manual intervention is needed.
- REJECTED: Do not retry immediately; review the user’s existing referral activity before advising next steps.
- ERROR: Retry later or escalate internally if the condition persists.# Credit Card Referral Offers and Restrictions

## Program scope
- Each credit card type has its own referral bonus and eligibility requirements that are not detailed here.

## Weekly referral limit
- You can receive at most 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 7-day window.
- If you attempt to receive more than 2 referrals in a single week, the third referral (and any subsequent referrals that week) will be automatically denied.
- This limit applies across all credit card types; referrals from different cards still count toward the same weekly cap.

## Practical guidance
- Track the timing of your last two successful referral bonuses before sending additional referrals.
- A rolling 7-day window means the count is evaluated based on the exact timestamps of your most recent referral bonuses, not calendar weeks.
- Auto-denied referrals due to the limit cannot be reinstated within the same 7-day window.
- If a referral is denied for hitting the limit, wait until enough time has passed to drop under the cap before attempting another.# Submitting a Cash Back Dispute (Internal)

Use this process when a customer believes there is a discrepancy between the cash back they received for a particular transaction and the cash back they should have received. This process applies to all credit card transactions.

## How to submit the dispute
Instead of a step-by-step workflow, instruct the customer to use the tool directly:

- Tool to provide to the user: `submit_cash_back_dispute_0589(user_id: str, transaction_id: str)`

## Overview

- Use `unlock_discoverable_agent_tool` to unlock the agent tool `update_transaction_rewards_3847`.

3) Recalculate the correct rewards
- Recalculate the correct rewards for each transaction based on the card type, transaction category, and any applicable promotions.

## Notes

- Purchases in non-bonus categories earn the card’s default rate.
- This document lists categories only and does not specify reward rates for any card.# Internal: Credit Card Rewards - Points vs Cash Back Representation

## Rewards representation
Due to a legacy backend migration that has not yet been completed, all credit card rewards in the transaction database are stored as 'points' regardless of whether the card is a cash back card or a points-based card. For cash back cards (Bronze Rewards Card, Silver Rewards Card, Gold Rewards Card, Platinum Rewards Card, Diamond Elite Card, Crypto-Cash Back, Business Bronze Rewards Card, Business Silver Rewards Card, Green Rewards Card, Silver Zoom Card, Business Gold Rewards Card, and Business Platinum Rewards Card), these 'points' should be interpreted as cash back with a conversion rate of 1 point = $0.01 when redeemed as a statement credit or as a credit to the user's Rho-Bank checking account. For example, 250 points equals $2.50 in cash back, which matches a 2.5% cash back rate on a $100 purchase. The only true points-based card is the EcoCard, which earns 'sustainability points' (5 points per dollar on green purchases, 1 point per dollar on other purchases) that also redeem at $0.01 per point when redeemed as a statement credit or checking account credit.# Credit Card Rewards Points Rounding Policy

## Rounding policy
All credit card rewards points are rounded down to the nearest whole number. When calculating points earned on a purchase, the system always truncates (floors) fractional points rather than rounding to the nearest integer. For example, a $126.77 purchase on a 1% cash back card earns 126 points (not 127), because 126.77 × 0.01 = 1.2677 points, which rounds down to 1 point per dollar, giving 126 points. Similarly, a $99.99 purchase at 2.5% cash back would calculate to 249.975 points but would award 249 points. This rounding policy applies consistently across all credit card types and reward categories.# Credit Card Rewards Redemption Options

## Redemption options and values
Rho-Bank credit card rewards points can be redeemed through several different methods, each with its own redemption value. The available redemption options are:

**Statement Credit** - 1 point = $0.01 (1 cent per point). Points are applied directly to your credit card balance to reduce your next statement. Minimum redemption: 500 points ($5.00).

**Rho-Bank Checking Account Credit** - 1 point = $0.01 (1 cent per point). Points are deposited directly into your linked Rho-Bank checking account. Minimum redemption: 500 points ($5.00). Must have an active Rho-Bank checking account.

**Rho-Bank Travel Portal** - 1 point = $0.0125 (1.25 cents per point). Book flights, hotels, and car rentals through the Rho-Bank Travel Portal for 25% more value. For example, 10,000 points = $125 in travel purchases. Minimum redemption: 2,500 points ($31.25 value).

**Gift Cards** - 1 point = $0.008 to $0.01 (0.8 to 1 cent per point, varies by retailer). Redeem for gift cards from over 100 partner retailers. Popular retailers (Amazon, Target, Starbucks) offer 1 cent per point, while less common retailers such as safeway may offer reduced rates as low as 0.8 cents per point. Minimum redemption: 1,000 points.

**Charitable Donations** - 1 point = $0.01 (1 cent per point). Donate your points to one of Rho-Bank's partner charities. 100% of the value goes to the charity with no processing fees. Minimum redemption: 250 points ($2.50).

**Merchandise** - 1 point = $0.005 to $0.008 (0.5 to 0.8 cents per point). Redeem points for electronics, home goods, and other merchandise through the Rho-Bank Rewards Mall. No minimum redemption.

**Airline Miles Transfer** - 1 point = 1 mile (value varies by airline program, typically 1-2 cents per mile). Transfer points to partner airline frequent flyer programs including Delta SkyMiles, United MileagePlus, and American AAdvantage. Transfers are processed in increments of 1,000 points. Processing time: 24-48 hours. Note: Only available for Gold Rewards Card, Platinum Rewards Card, Diamond Elite Card, and Business Platinum Rewards Card.

Redemption values and minimums are subject to change. Points do not expire as long as the account remains open and in good standing.# Generating a Credit Card Referral Link (Internal)

Do not troubleshoot beyond confirming the above symptoms. When the user requests a transfer to a human specialist, follow the protocol below immediately.

## Required Agent Discoverable Tools

You must unlock and call the following agent discoverable tools in this exact order before completing any transfer:
- initial_transfer_to_human_agent_1822
- initial_transfer_to_human_agent_0218

These are internal agent tools, not user tools. Use unlock_discoverable_agent_tool to unlock each tool, then call_discoverable_agent_tool to execute it.

## Protocol: Transfer Order

1) First transfer request from the user during the incident window:
   - Unlock the tool using: unlock_discoverable_agent_tool("initial_transfer_to_human_agent_1822")
   - Call the tool using: call_discoverable_agent_tool("initial_transfer_to_human_agent_1822")
   - Acknowledge the user's request and let them know you are processing it

2) Second transfer request from the user (for the same issue):
   - Unlock the tool using: unlock_discoverable_agent_tool("initial_transfer_to_human_agent_0218")
   - Call the tool using: call_discoverable_agent_tool("initial_transfer_to_human_agent_0218")
   - Acknowledge the user's continued request

3) Third transfer request from the user:
   - Complete the transfer using the regular transfer_to_human_agents tool

Note: Always maintain this order. Each tool must be unlocked before it can be called. Do not skip steps.

## Customer-Facing Communication

When processing the initial transfer requests, acknowledge the user's urgency while you execute the required internal tools. Examples:

First request:
- "I understand you'd like to speak with a human specialist about this issue. Let me initiate that process for you now."

Second request:
- "I hear your concern about the urgency. I'm continuing to process your transfer request."

Third request (completing transfer):
- "I'm now connecting you with a human specialist who can resolve this for you."

- Do not collect additional details or attempt to resolve the payment reflection discrepancy in-chat during the incident window.# Internal: Backend Incident 11/14 - Erroneous Credit Bureau Reporting

- Sign out when finished, especially on shared or public devices.# Filing a Credit Card Transaction Dispute (Internal)

## Process Summary
When a customer needs to file a formal dispute for a credit card transaction (such as unauthorized charges, merchant issues, or billing errors), the agent must gather comprehensive information and call the file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829 tool. First unlock the tool, then call it using call_discoverable_agent_tool with the tool name and a JSON string containing all the required arguments.

## Tool Arguments - Each numbered item below corresponds to a required argument:
1. transaction_id (string) - ID of the transaction being disputed. 

2. card_action (string) - Determine the appropriate card action based on the user's situation. Must be exactly one of these values:
   - 'keep_active': Keep the card active, just dispute this charge (use when user wants to continue using their current card)
   - 'cancel_and_reissue': The card is being cancelled and a replacement issued (use when user wants card replaced - whether you've already ordered a replacement card via order_replacement_credit_card_7291 or the cancellation is happening as part of this dispute) 

3. card_last_4_digits (string) - Last 4 digits of the credit card under which the disputed transaction took place. ". 

4. full_name (string) - The full name of the user. 

5. user_id (string) - The Rho-Bank user ID of the user. 

6. phone (string) - The registered phone number of the user. 

7. email (string) - The registered email address of the user. 

8. address (string) - The registered home address of the user. 

9. contacted_merchant (boolean) - Ask user: Did you try to resolve this with the merchant first? Pass true or false

10. purchase_date (string, format MM/DD/YYYY) - The date in which the disputed transaction occurred. 

11. issue_noticed_date (string, format MM/DD/YYYY) - Ask user when they noticed the issue. 

12. dispute_reason (string) - Ask user to select one. Must be exactly one of these values:
   - 'unauthorized_fraudulent_charge': Charge was not authorized or is fraudulent
   - 'duplicate_charge': Same charge appeared multiple times
   - 'incorrect_amount': Amount charged differs from expected
   - 'goods_services_not_received': Never received what was paid for
   - 'goods_services_not_as_described': Received item/service differs from description
   - 'canceled_subscription_still_charging': Subscription was cancelled but charges continue
   - 'refund_never_processed': Merchant promised refund but it was never applied

13. resolution_requested (string) - Ask user what resolution they want. Must be exactly one of these values:
    - 'full_refund': Complete refund of the transaction amount
    - 'partial_refund': Partial amount (must also provide partial_refund_amount)
    - 'reversal_of_charge': Charge reversal/chargeback

14. partial_refund_amount (number, optional) - Only required if resolution_requested is 'partial_refund'. The dollar amount for the partial refund.

15. eligible_for_provisional_credit (boolean) - Agent must determine this based on the Provisional Credit Eligibility Guidelines article in this knowledge base. Pass true or false.# Provisional Credit Eligibility Guidelines (Internal)

When processing a credit card transaction dispute, you must determine whether the customer is eligible for provisional credit. Provisional credit means the disputed amount is temporarily credited back to the customer's account while the investigation is ongoing.

## Eligibility Criteria — Customer is ELIGIBLE for provisional credit if ALL of the following are true:
1. Account Standing: The customer's credit card account has been open for at least 60 days

# Diamond Elite Card: Invitation-Only Membership - How to Qualify

## Eligibility at a glance
- Membership is by invitation only (Yes).
- You should maintain a credit score of at least $780 to be considered.

## How invitations are typically extended
- Invitations are sent to clients who demonstrate exceptional creditworthiness and responsible account management.
- A history of timely payments, low credit utilization, and substantial verifiable income increases your likelihood of being invited.
- Relationship depth with Rho-Bank (deposit history, assets under management, and tenure) may be reviewed when invitations are determined.

## Strengthen your candidacy
- Keep your credit utilization well below industry norms to help support a score at or above $780.
- Avoid late or missed payments and minimize recent hard inquiries.
- Maintain steady income documentation and up-to-date contact information so you do not miss an invitation outreach.

## Important notes
- Receiving an invitation is not guaranteed even if your score is at or above $780.
- Invitations are time-limited; respond promptly if you receive one.# Diamond Elite Card: Getting Started with Your Elite Account

## Activate and secure your card
1. Activate your card as instructed in your welcome kit.
2. Set a strong PIN and enable transaction alerts for purchases and cash advances.

## Understand initial terms
- Annual fee: $495.00 (billed to your first statement unless waived by an applicable promo).
- Purchase APR for carried balances: 15.99%.
- Late payment fee: $32.50.

## Review your credit line
- Your starting credit limit will fall within $37,500 to $375,000, based on a review of your profile.
- If you expect large upcoming purchases, consider requesting a proactive limit review after your first statement is generated.

## Set up payments
- Enroll in AutoPay to avoid interest on new purchases and to reduce the risk of incurring the $32.50.
- Choose statement balance or total balance to minimize interest charges at the 15.99%.

## Digital controls and virtual cards
- Virtual card management is available (Yes). Create unique numbers for merchants, set per-card limits, and freeze or delete virtual cards if needed.

## Concierge at your service
- Access elite assistance any time (Yes). Use it to coordinate reservations, trip logistics, or hard-to-book events.

## First statement checklist
- Confirm the posted $495.00 and verify any expected credits or adjustments.
- Review your credit limit and payment due date, and confirm your AutoPay setup.# Diamond Elite Card: Earning 5% Cash Back on All Purchases

## How you earn
- You earn 5.0% cash back on all eligible purchases posted to your account.
- Rewards accrue when transactions post (typically within a few days of the purchase date).

## What to expect on your statement
- Each billing cycle shows your new rewards earned, prior balance, redemptions, and any adjustments for returns.
- If a purchase is returned, the associated cash back will be reversed.

## Redemption threshold
- You can redeem once your available rewards balance meets at least 5.

## Practical tips
- Use the card for everyday and large purchases to maximize the 5.0% rate.
- Keep your account in good standing to ensure rewards post without delay.

## Example calculation
- Rewards on a purchase = Purchase amount × 5.0%.# Diamond Elite Card: Maximizing Your 5% Rewards on Every Transaction

## Make every eligible dollar count
- Route high-value purchases through your card to capture 5.0%.
- Consolidate recurring bills (subscriptions, utilities, insurance) on your card to steadily build rewards.

## Optimize redemption
- Track your rewards balance and redeem as soon as you meet 5 to turn earnings into statement savings.
- Schedule a monthly review so you do not leave rewards idle.

## Prevent lost rewards
- Ensure autopay or timely manual payments so your account remains in good standing and rewards post as expected.
- Avoid using the card for non-earning transactions (e.g., fees or cash equivalents) that do not generate the 5.0%.

## Monitor and adjust
- Review merchant-level spending monthly to identify opportunities to move additional eligible spend to the card.
- If a transaction posts incorrectly, contact support promptly to review the rewards accrual.# Diamond Elite Card: Premium Credit Limits and Account Management

## Your credit limits
- Standard range: $37,500 to $375,000.
- Initial assignment is based on your credit profile and historical capacity to manage large lines.

## Payment expectations
- Minimum payment: 3.0% of your statement balance each cycle (or the statement minimum, if higher).
- Late payment fee: $32.50 if your payment is received after the due date.
- Interest on carried balances: 15.99%. Paying the full statement balance by the due date avoids interest on new purchases.

## Managing large purchases
- For transactions approaching your limit, consider requesting a temporary limit review in advance.
- Set real-time alerts to monitor available credit before high-value charges.

## Limit increases
- Demonstrate on-time payments and low utilization for several cycles before requesting a review.
- Provide current income documentation to support a higher limit within the $37,500–$375,000 range.

## Avoiding fees and interest
- Enroll in autopay and schedule payments a few days before the due date.
- If you must carry a balance, plan a paydown schedule to reduce exposure to the 15.99%.# Diamond Elite Card: Understanding Your Annual Fee and Elite Benefits

## Annual fee
- Your standard annual fee is $495.00. It appears on your first statement and on the anniversary each year thereafter unless waived by a qualifying promotion.
- Interest on carried balances, if any, accrues at 15.99% and is separate from the annual fee.

## Invitation promo: fee waiver and credit
- If you meet the invitation spending requirement of $50,000 within the specified promo period, your annual fee is waived (Yes).
- You also receive a $5,000 statement credit after qualification.

## How the waiver and credit apply
- The $495.00 will be waived on the billing statement after you satisfy the $50,000.
- The $5,000 posts after qualification is confirmed; timing may vary by billing cycle.

## If you do not meet the requirement
- The standard $495.00 remains on your account.
- You can still avoid interest by paying your statement balance in full, even if the fee is not waived.

## Verification tips
- Track your cumulative spend toward $50,000 during the promo window and keep all receipts.
- Review the first two statements carefully to confirm the waiver and credit have posted.# Diamond Elite Card: Exclusive Benefits and 24/7 Concierge Services

## Concierge access
- You have round-the-clock elite assistance (Yes). Use it to coordinate reservations, complex itineraries, and high-demand events.
- For time-sensitive requests, include preferred times, budgets, and alternates to speed fulfillment.

## International advantage
- Foreign transaction fee: 0%. Use your card abroad without added bank conversion fees.

## Purchase protection
- Covered purchase window: 150 days from the date of purchase.
- Coverage maximum: Unlimited (Yes), subject to policy terms and exclusions.
- To file a claim, retain your itemized receipt, proof of loss or damage, and any police or carrier reports (if applicable).

## Best practices
- For high-value items, photograph the item and serial number at purchase to streamline claims.
- When traveling internationally, notify concierge of your itinerary so they can assist with bookings and provide local recommendations.# Diamond Elite Card: No Foreign Transaction Fees - Global Purchasing Power

## What you save
- Foreign transaction fee: 0%. Your international purchases are not subject to additional bank conversion fees.

## Using your card abroad
- Pay in local currency when offered a choice to avoid unfavorable dynamic currency conversion rates.
- Enable travel alerts so legitimate international activity is recognized.
- Keep merchant receipts until transactions post and exchange rates settle.

## Disputes and returns
- If a charge posts incorrectly after currency conversion, contact support promptly with the receipt and transaction details.
- Returns may take longer to appear internationally; monitor statements until the credit posts.# Diamond Elite Card: Invitation Promo Offer - Spend and Earn Rewards

# Crypto-Cash Back: Getting Started with Crypto Rewards

## Before You Begin
- Confirm that crypto redemptions are available on your account: Yes.
- Note that purchase protection on this card is No.

## How to Start Earning Rewards You Can Redeem in Crypto
1. Make eligible purchases with your card. You earn rewards at 2.0% on those transactions.
2. Track your reward balance in the app. You can prepare for crypto redemption once your balance reaches at least 30 dollars.
3. If you prefer to segregate spending for specific projects or merchants, use virtual cards (when available) to organize and monitor reward accrual. Virtual card management availability: Yes.

## Tips for a Smooth Start
- Set a personal target for your first crypto redemption that meets or exceeds 30.
- Plan larger purchases strategically to accelerate reaching the threshold while staying within your budget.
- Review merchant processing categories in your statements to confirm which transactions earned rewards at the 2.0% rate.

## When You’re Ready to Redeem
- Verify your reward balance has met the 30 requirement.
- Proceed to the crypto redemption flow in the app to choose your cryptocurrency and destination wallet.

## Common Questions at Setup
- How much do I earn per purchase? You earn 2.0%.
- What is the minimum balance to redeem to crypto? 30 dollars.
- Can I organize spending with virtual cards? Yes.# Crypto-Cash Back: How to Redeem Rewards in Your Crypto Wallet

## Prerequisites
- Crypto redemption availability on your account: Yes.
- Minimum reward balance to redeem: 30 dollars.

## Step-by-Step Redemption
1. Open Rewards in your app and choose Redeem to Crypto.
2. Confirm your current reward balance meets the 30 threshold.
3. Select a cryptocurrency from the available list (up to 12 options).
4. Choose your transfer method:
   - If direct wallet integration is available: Yes
   - Otherwise, use manual wallet address entry.
5. Review the estimated conversion. A conversion fee of 1.25% applies to the rewards you convert.
6. Confirm your wallet address and submit the redemption request.

## Timing and Fees
- Conversion fee: 1.25% (applied at the time of conversion).
- The number of available cryptocurrencies can be up to 12.

## Troubleshooting
- Can’t proceed? Ensure your redemption is enabled: Yes.
- Threshold not met? Accumulate more rewards until you reach 30.
- Integration unavailable? If Yes is False, enter your wallet address manually and confirm accuracy before submitting.# Crypto-Cash Back: Supported Cryptocurrencies and Wallets

## Availability Overview
- Crypto redemptions on this program: Yes.
- Number of cryptocurrencies supported for redemption: up to 12.

## Supported Wallet Connections
- Direct wallet integration supported: Yes.
- If direct integration is not supported, you can use manual wallet address entry.

## Selecting a Cryptocurrency
- You can choose from a curated list of up to 12 cryptocurrencies during redemption.
- The list may change over time based on liquidity, security, and network considerations.

## Wallet Compatibility Guidance
- If Yes is True:
  - Link your wallet directly within the app and select it at checkout during redemption.
- If Yes is False:
  - Paste your compatible public wallet address for the selected asset during redemption and verify it carefully.

## Best Practices
- Confirm that your wallet supports the network of the selected cryptocurrency.
- Use a new address only after validating it with a small test transfer in your external wallet, when possible.# Crypto-Cash Back: Linking Your Crypto Wallet to Your Account

## Determine Your Connection Method
- Direct wallet integration availability: Yes.

## If Direct Integration Is Supported
1. Go to Settings > Crypto Wallets in your app.
2. Choose Add Wallet and select your wallet provider.
3. Authenticate with your wallet provider and approve permissions.
4. Set this wallet as your default destination for crypto redemptions.
5. Complete a verification step if prompted (e.g., signing a message).

## If Direct Integration Is Not Supported
1. Navigate to Rewards > Redeem to Crypto.
2. Select your cryptocurrency and choose Manual Address.
3. Paste your public wallet address and, if applicable, the required memo/tag.
4. Verify the address format and network before saving.
5. Save the address for future redemptions and consider labeling it for clarity.

## Verification Tips
- Always verify the network (e.g., native chain vs. tokenized variants) matches your wallet’s expected format.
- Test with a small redemption after setup to ensure proper delivery before sending larger amounts.# Crypto-Cash Back: Understanding Crypto Reward Conversion Rates

## How Your Rewards Convert
- You earn rewards at 2.0% on eligible purchases.
- When you redeem to crypto, a conversion fee of 1.25% applies to the amount you convert.

## Estimating Your Crypto Payout
- Net rewards converted = Your available rewards × (1 − 1.25%).
- The resulting fiat amount is then exchanged at the real-time market rate into your selected cryptocurrency.

## Practical Planning Tips
- If you anticipate price volatility, consider redeeming in smaller tranches instead of a single large conversion.
- Compare your expected net amount before and after applying the 1.25% to decide when to redeem.
- Remember that rewards accrue at 2.0% regardless of crypto market conditions; only the redemption reflects market pricing.# Crypto-Cash Back: Security and Safety of Crypto Redemptions

## Key Considerations
- Purchase protection on this card is No. Factor this into your decision-making when redeeming and spending.

## Address Verification Best Practices
- Double-check the exact public address and network before confirming a redemption.
- Use saved, verified addresses whenever possible to reduce manual entry errors.
- If your wallet requires a memo/tag, include it accurately; missing or incorrect tags may lead to loss of funds.

## Platform Controls You Can Use
- Enable notifications for redemption confirmations so you can quickly detect any unexpected activity.
- Lock your card or pause redemptions if you suspect unauthorized access until you review activity.

## After You Redeem
- Monitor the transaction status in your wallet and the app for confirmations.
- Keep records of redemption details for reconciliation and potential tax reporting needs.# Crypto-Cash Back: Tax Reporting for Cryptocurrency Rewards

## Document Availability
- Tax reporting documents for crypto redemptions provided: Yes.

## What You Should Do
- Download your annual statements and any provided tax forms related to crypto redemptions.
- Keep detailed records of redemption dates, amounts, and the assets received for your own reporting.

## Timing and Access
- Check the app’s Documents or Tax section after year-end for access to any available forms.
- If additional documentation is required, export your transaction history and provide it to your tax professional.

## Important Notes
- Redemption events may have tax implications depending on your jurisdiction.
- Consult a qualified tax advisor for guidance tailored to your situation.# Crypto-Cash Back: Frequently Asked Questions About Crypto Rewards

## Earning and Redemption
- How much do I earn on purchases? You earn 2.0% on eligible spend.
- What is the minimum to redeem to crypto? 30 dollars.
- How many cryptocurrencies can I choose from? Up to 12.
- Is there a conversion fee when redeeming to crypto? 1.25%.

## Costs and Limits Related to Crypto Rewards
- Do I need to pay an annual fee to access the rewards program? Annual fee: $75.00 dollars.
- Does carrying a balance affect my rewards? Your APR for carried balances is 19.49%, which does not change the earn rate but may affect your overall costs.
- Do credit limits impact how much I can earn? Your available credit range is $5,000 to $110,000 dollars; higher spend capacity can influence total rewards earned.

## Other Program Considerations
- Are tax documents provided for crypto redemptions? Yes.
- What is the foreign transaction fee if I use the card abroad? 0%.
- Can I use virtual cards and still earn rewards? Yes.

| Component | Value |
|---|---|
| Gold Savings base APY | 5.5% |
| Gold Rewards Card relationship bonus | +0.025% |
| **Total effective APY** | **5.525%** |

- Silver Rewards Card: **$0 annual fee**, no subscription needed, **minimum credit score 680** (lower bar than the Gold Rewards Card's 720).

## Why these beat the alternatives
- Silver/Silver Plus/Bronze Savings accounts top out net benefit around **$196–$326** even with their best card pairing, due to lower base APY or fees eating into the gain.
- Platinum/Platinum Plus/Diamond Elite Savings require $25,000–$250,000 minimum balances — out of reach with $8,000.

## My recommendation
If your credit profile can support a **720+ score**, the **Gold Savings Account + Gold Rewards Card** combo nets you about **$26 more** over the year than the backup option (and meaningfully more than any other combination) — clearing your $10–15 threshold for mattering.

If you're not sure you'd qualify for the Gold Rewards Card (720+ score), the **Green Account (Savings) + Silver Rewards Card** combo is the strongest fallback with an easier 680 score threshold and zero extra costs.

Would you like me to proceed with opening either combination? I'll need to verify your identity first (two of: date of birth, email, phone number, or address), and I'll also need to confirm your Light Blue checking account's tenure and that you don't already hold the maximum number of savings accounts.

If your credit profile can support a **720+ score**, the **Gold Savings Account + Gold Rewards Card** combo nets you about **$26 more** over the year than the backup option (and meaningfully more than any other combination) — clearing your $10–15 threshold for mattering.

If you're not sure you'd qualify for the Gold Rewards Card (720+ score), the **Green Account (Savings) + Silver Rewards Card** combo is the strongest fallback with an easier 680 score threshold and zero extra costs.

Would you like me to proceed with opening either combination? I'll need to verify your identity first (two of: date of birth, email, phone number, or address), and I'll also need to confirm your Light Blue checking account's tenure and that you don't already hold the maximum number of savings accounts.

# Bronze Rewards Card: Understanding Your 1% Cash Back Rewards

## What You Earn on Each Purchase
- You earn 1.0% cash back on eligible purchases.
- There is no annual fee of $0.00, so your rewards are not reduced by a membership charge.

## How Rewards Accrue
- Rewards are calculated on the posted amount of each eligible purchase.
- If a purchase is returned or refunded, the corresponding rewards are reversed.
- Disputed transactions do not earn rewards until resolved and posted.

## Eligible vs. Ineligible Transactions
- Eligible: Everyday purchases where the transaction posts normally.
- Typically ineligible: Fees, interest charges, and cash‑like transactions (for example, some money transfers) generally do not earn rewards.

## Tracking Your Earn Rates
- Each posted purchase contributes 1.0% to your rewards balance.
- Your monthly statement and online account show rewards earned by cycle and in total.

## Tips to Maximize Earnings
- Consolidate day‑to‑day purchases on this card to capture the flat 1.0% on all spend.
- Avoid returns where possible, as they reduce earned rewards.
- Review statements to confirm all posted purchases were credited properly.# Bronze Rewards Card: When and How Are Cash Back Rewards Paid?

## When Rewards Become Available
- Rewards accrue at 1.0% as eligible purchases post to your account.
- Pending transactions do not earn rewards until they settle and post.

## Redemption Threshold
- You can redeem once your available rewards balance reaches at least $17.

## How to Redeem
1. Go to your card’s rewards section in your online account.
2. Confirm your available rewards balance is $17 or higher.
3. Choose your redemption option (for example, statement credit) and submit.
4. You will receive confirmation once your redemption request is processed.

## Payout Timing
- Most redemptions process within a few business days after you submit the request.
- If your redemption occurs near a statement closing date, it may appear on the next statement cycle.

## Helpful Notes
- Partial redemptions are allowed as long as each request meets the $17 minimum.
- Returned purchases reduce your available rewards and may affect payout eligibility if they bring your balance below $17.# Bronze Rewards Card: Redeeming Your Rewards and Cash Back Options

## When You Can Redeem
- You can initiate a redemption once your available rewards balance reaches $17.

## Redemption Options
- Statement credit: Apply rewards to reduce your current card balance.
- On‑demand redemption: Redeem whenever you reach $17 or more.
- Auto‑redeem: Set preferences to automatically redeem when your balance meets the threshold.

## How Much You Receive
- Your rewards accrue at 1.0% on eligible purchases; your redeemable balance reflects the total accrued rewards minus any reversals for returns.

## Steps to Redeem
1. Go to the rewards section in your online account.
2. Confirm your available rewards are at least $17.
3. Choose the redemption option and amount.
4. Submit and review the confirmation.

## Tips
- If you make frequent small purchases, enabling auto‑redeem helps ensure steady credits once you pass $17.
- Check for pending returns before redeeming to avoid falling below the minimum after reversals.

1. Credit Card APY Bonuses: Stacking Policy
   ID: doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_045
   Score: 17.4655
   Content: ## Credit Card APY Bonus Stacking Policy

When a customer holds multiple Rho-Bank credit cards that each provide an APY bonus on their savings account, the bonuses do NOT stack. Only the highest applicable credit card APY bonus is applied to the customer's savings account.

### How it works

1. The system identifies all active Rho-Bank credit cards linked to the customer's profile.
2. For each credit card, the corresponding APY bonus is determined.
3. Only the HIGHEST credit card APY bonus is applied to the savings account.
4. Other credit card bonuses are not added on top.

### Example

If a customer holds:
- Gold Rewards Card: +0.025% APY bonus
- Platinum Rewards Card: +0.15% APY bonus
- EcoCard: +0.6% APY bonus

The customer receives only the EcoCard bonus of +0.6% (the highest), not the sum of all three.

### Important distinctions

- Credit card APY bonuses do NOT stack with each other.
- However, credit card APY bonuses DO stack with other types of bonuses, such as:
  - Checking account APY boosts (e.g., Green Account checking boost)
  - Relationship bonuses for holding multiple Rho-Bank products
  - Account tier bonuses

### Why this policy exists

This policy ensures that customers receive a meaningful benefit for holding premium credit cards while maintaining sustainable interest rates across the product portfolio.

2. Silver Plus Saver Account: Relationship bonuses explained
   ID: doc_business_savings_accounts_silver_plus_saver_003
   Score: 17.3172
   Content: ## How the relationship bonus works
- When you qualify based on holding multiple eligible Rho-Bank products, your Silver Plus Saver APY receives an additive bonus of 0.025%.
- The relationship bonus is applied on top of the APY you earn from your balance tier.

### Applying the bonus to your account
- Eligibility is evaluated based on your relationship status with Rho-Bank.
- Once eligible, the 0.025% increment is added to the APY associated with your current tier for the period you qualify.
- If eligibility changes, the bonus adjusts prospectively.

### Fee considerations
- If you do not meet the minimum balance requirement, a monthly maintenance fee of $10.00 is assessed according to your account terms.
- The relationship bonus affects your APY; it does not change how the monthly maintenance fee is determined.

### Practical tips
- Periodically review your product holdings to ensure you continue to qualify for the relationship bonus.
- Monitor your balance relative to the minimum requirement so that any potential $10.00 does not reduce your interest gains, especially when the 0.025% is active.

3. Linking Silver Account with a Rho checking account
   ID: doc_savings_accounts_silver_account_002
   Score: 14.9126
   Content: ## What linking does
- When you link your Silver Account to a Rho-Bank checking account, your Silver APY receives an additional [[linked_checking_apy_bonus]].
- If you maintain multiple Rho-Bank products, you may also qualify for a relationship bonus of 0.025% that stacks on top of your base Silver APY.

## How to link your accounts
- From your Rho-Bank dashboard, open your Silver Account and choose the option to link a Rho checking account.
- Confirm both accounts are under the same ownership and tax ID.
- Complete the on-screen authorization to finalize the link; APY adjustments typically appear shortly after linking.

## Ongoing eligibility
- Keep both accounts open and in good standing. Unlinking the checking account can remove the [[linked_checking_apy_bonus]] and may affect your eligibility for the 0.025%.

4. Silver Account: Platinum Rewards Card holder benefits
   ID: doc_savings_accounts_silver_account_009
   Score: 14.8292
   Content: ## Overview

Silver Account holders who also have a Platinum Rewards Card receive enhanced withdrawal privileges. Your monthly withdrawal limit is increased by 5 additional free withdrawals, bringing your total to 10 + 5 = 15 withdrawals per month. This benefit is automatically applied when both accounts are linked under the same customer profile. Combined with the existing 15 ATM fee rebates and 0.025% relationship bonus, Platinum Rewards Card holders get an elevated Silver Account experience.

## APY bonuses from credit cards
- Platinum Rewards Card: +0.2%
- Diamond Elite Card: +0.25%

## What you receive as a Platinum Rewards Card holder

- Additional free withdrawals: +5 per month on top of your standard 10 free withdrawals
- Total free withdrawals per month: 10 + 5 = 15
- ATM fee relief: Up to 15 in ATM fee rebates each month
- Earnings boost: An additional 0.025% relationship bonus added to your APY when eligible

## Activation and eligibility

- The enhanced withdrawal limit is automatically applied when your Silver Account and Platinum Rewards Card are linked under the same customer profile.
- The 0.025% relationship bonus and 15 ATM fee rebates apply in the same profile-linked setup.

### How to confirm your accounts are linked

1. Sign in to Rho-Bank Online Banking or the mobile app.
2. Open your customer profile and review your list of accounts and cards.
3. Verify that your Silver Account and Platinum Rewards Card appear under the same customer profile.
4. If you do not see both products under one profile, consolidate them to a single profile or contact us for assistance.

## Using your monthly withdrawal allowance

- Counting method: Any transaction classified as a withdrawal under your Silver Account terms counts toward your monthly total of 15 free withdrawals.
- Cycle timing: Your free withdrawal count resets at the start of each monthly statement cycle.
- Beyond the limit: Transactions above your free monthly total may be subject to standard Silver Account withdrawal charges.

Example:
- You make 12 withdrawals in a month: all 12 are free.
- You make 15 withdrawals in a month: all 15 are free.
- You make 16 withdrawals in a month: the first 15 are free; the 16th may incur standard charges.

## ATM fee rebates

- You are eligible for up to 15 in ATM fee rebates each month.
- Rebates apply after ATM fees post to your Silver Account; check your transaction history for the corresponding credit within the same month.

## Relationship bonus APY

- When your Silver Account and Platinum Rewards Card are linked under the same customer profile, an additional 0.025% is added to your APY as a relationship bonus.
- The relationship bonus is reflected in your APY while eligibility is maintained.

## Troubleshooting and tips

- If you do not see the extra withdrawals or 0.025% reflected, confirm both products are under the same customer profile.
- Check that you are within the current monthly statement cycle for the added withdrawals to apply.
- Review your transaction history to verify ATM fee charges and corresponding rebates up to 15 for the month.

5. Linked Checking Account APY Boost: Selection Policy
   ID: doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_046
   Score: 13.9041
   Content: ## Multiple Checking Account APY Boost Selection Policy

When a customer holds multiple Rho-Bank checking accounts that each provide an APY boost on their savings account, the boosts do NOT stack. Only the highest applicable checking account APY boost is applied to the customer's savings account.

### How it works

1. The system identifies all active Rho-Bank checking accounts linked to the customer's profile.
2. For each checking account, the corresponding APY boost for the savings account type is determined.
3. Only the HIGHEST checking account APY boost is applied to the savings account.
4. Other checking account boosts are not added on top.

### Example

If a customer with a Gold Savings Account holds:
- Green Account (checking): +0.75% APY boost
- Purple Account (checking): +0.1% APY boost

The customer receives only the Green Account boost of +0.75% (the highest), not the sum of both.

### Important distinctions

- Checking account APY boosts do NOT stack with each other.
- However, checking account APY boosts DO stack with other types of bonuses, such as:
  - Credit card APY bonuses (only highest credit card bonus applies)
  - Relationship bonuses for holding multiple Rho-Bank products
  - Account tier bonuses

### Why this policy exists

This policy ensures that customers receive a meaningful benefit for holding premium checking accounts while maintaining sustainable interest rates across the product portfolio.

### Agent Responsibility

When investigating interest discrepancies for customers with multiple checking accounts, agents must:
1. Identify all checking accounts the customer holds
2. Determine which checking account provides the highest APY boost for the savings account type
3. Verify that the system is applying the highest boost, not a lower one
4. If the system selected the wrong checking account, calculate the correct APY and apply an interest correction

6. Internal: Submitting Interest Discrepancy Reports
   ID: doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_044
   Score: 13.1783
   Content: When a customer's savings account interest calculation is incorrect, agents must submit an interest discrepancy report to the backend team for investigation. Use the submit_interest_discrepancy_report_7294 tool to create this report.

When to Submit a Report:

1. Missing APY Boost: Customer has a qualifying checking-savings account pairing but the linked checking APY boost was not applied to their interest calculation.

2. Incorrect Tier Rate: Customer's balance qualifies for a higher APY tier but the lower tier rate was applied.

3. Missing Relationship Bonus: Customer maintains multiple Rho-Bank products but the relationship bonus was not applied.

4. System Calculation Error: Any other discrepancy between expected and actual interest credited.

Tool: submit_interest_discrepancy_report_7294
Parameters:
- account_id (string): The savings account ID with the discrepancy
- user_id (string): The customer's unique identifier
- expected_apy (number): The APY percentage the customer should have received (e.g., 2.775 for 2.775%)
- actual_apy (number): The APY percentage that was actually applied (e.g., 2.5 for 2.5%)
- amount_difference (number): The dollar amount difference between expected and actual interest credited

Procedure:
1) Verify the customer's identity and account ownership
2) Look up the customer's accounts using get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847
3) Check transaction history using get_bank_account_transactions_9173 to find the interest credit
4) Review documentation for the savings account type to determine all applicable APY components (base rate, tier rate, linked checking boost, credit card bonuses, relationship bonus)
5) Calculate the expected APY by adding all applicable components
6) Calculate the discrepancy between expected and actual interest
7) If a discrepancy exists, first apply a credit using apply_savings_account_credit_6831 to correct the customer's account
8) Then submit the discrepancy report using submit_interest_discrepancy_report_7294

Important: Always apply the credit to the customer's account BEFORE submitting the report. The report is for backend investigation to fix the underlying system issue, while the credit immediately resolves the customer's concern.

7. Beige Account Referral Program
   ID: doc_business_checking_accounts_beige_012
   Score: 12.4839
   Content: ## Enterprise referral program

Refer other enterprise-level businesses to the Beige Account and earn premium referral rewards.

- **Their reward**: $350 welcome bonus

8. Platinum Reserve Account: Business Credit Card APY Bonuses
   ID: doc_business_savings_accounts_platinum_reserve_account_010
   Score: 11.0828
   Content: ## Eligible Business Credit Cards and APY Bonuses

Holding an eligible Rho-Bank Business Rewards Card can increase the APY on your Platinum Reserve Account. The increase is additive to your current APY and is reflected in your displayed rate and daily interest accruals.

- Business Silver Rewards Card: adds 0.25% to your APY
- Business Gold Rewards Card: adds 0.5% to your APY
- Business Platinum Rewards Card: adds 0.8% to your APY

## How the APY Bonus Is Applied

- The bonus is added as a fixed number of percentage points to your Platinum Reserve Account’s APY based on your eligible card tier.
- The bonus is included in your total APY and affects interest that accrues daily and credits on your normal interest crediting schedule.
- The bonus applies only for the period during which you are eligible; if eligibility begins or ends mid-cycle, the APY used for daily accruals adjusts as of the effective date of that change.

## Verifying Your Bonus

- Check the APY shown in your Platinum Reserve Account details; the increase from your eligible card will be included in the displayed APY.
- Your interest activity will reflect the higher daily accrual associated with the bonus.
- If you hold more than one eligible card or have recently changed cards, contact your Rho-Bank representative to confirm which bonus is currently applied.

## Maintaining Eligibility

To keep the APY bonus active:
- Ensure the eligible Business Rewards Card remains active and in good standing.
- Keep the card associated with the same business entity that owns the Platinum Reserve Account.
- Notify Rho-Bank promptly if your business ownership structure or card status changes, so your APY can be updated accordingly.

## Starting, Changing, or Removing a Bonus

- New or upgraded card: Once eligibility is confirmed, your APY will reflect the applicable bonus going forward.
- Card downgrade, closure, or ineligibility: The APY bonus will no longer apply from the effective date of the change.
- Multiple cards: If your organization holds multiple eligible cards, your account will reflect the applicable bonus for your configuration; contact your Rho-Bank representative if you need confirmation.

## Example (for illustration only)

- If your Platinum Reserve Account APY is 3.00% and you hold a Business Platinum Rewards Card, your APY would increase by 0.8% to 3.80%.
- If your APY is 2.75% and you hold a Business Gold Rewards Card, your APY would increase by 0.5% to 3.25%.
- If your APY is 2.25% and you hold a Business Silver Rewards Card, your APY would increase by 0.25% to 2.50%.

   Score: 22.0325
   Content: ## How the relationship bonus works
- When you qualify based on holding multiple eligible Rho-Bank products, your Silver Plus Saver APY receives an additive bonus of 0.025%.
- The relationship bonus is applied on top of the APY you earn from your balance tier.

### Applying the bonus to your account
- Eligibility is evaluated based on your relationship status with Rho-Bank.
- Once eligible, the 0.025% increment is added to the APY associated with your current tier for the period you qualify.
- If eligibility changes, the bonus adjusts prospectively.

### Fee considerations
- If you do not meet the minimum balance requirement, a monthly maintenance fee of $10.00 is assessed according to your account terms.
- The relationship bonus affects your APY; it does not change how the monthly maintenance fee is determined.

### Practical tips
- Periodically review your product holdings to ensure you continue to qualify for the relationship bonus.
- Monitor your balance relative to the minimum requirement so that any potential $10.00 does not reduce your interest gains, especially when the 0.025% is active.

   Content: ## Eligibility and Minimum Balance
- You must maintain a minimum balance of $5,000 to keep the Silver Plus Saver account in good standing.
- If your balance is anticipated to dip below $5,000, consider timing deposits and withdrawals to avoid falling under the requirement.

## Interest and APY Structure
- Balances below the tier 2 threshold earn 2.5% APY.
- Balances above the tier 2 threshold earn 4.0% APY.

### Relationship APY Bonuses
If you hold an eligible Business Rewards Card, an APY bonus is added to your base APY:
- Business Silver Rewards Card: +0.18% APY
- Business Gold Rewards Card: +0.38% APY
- Business Platinum Rewards Card: +0.62% APY

The bonus applies to the base APY for the balance tier you qualify for.

### Example APYs With Relationship Bonuses
Below are example total APYs when a relationship bonus applies:

- Balance below tier 2 threshold (base 2.5%):
  - With Business Silver Rewards Card: 2.68% (2.5% + 0.18%)
  - With Business Gold Rewards Card: 2.88% (2.5% + 0.38%)
  - With Business Platinum Rewards Card: 3.12% (2.5% + 0.62%)

  - With Business Gold Rewards Card: 4.38% (4.0% + 0.38%)
  - With Business Platinum Rewards Card: 4.62% (4.0% + 0.62%)

## Withdrawals and Transfers
Silver Plus Saver offers higher withdrawal limits and improved transfer capabilities compared to Silver Saver. To make the most of these enhancements:
- Plan large withdrawals in advance to ensure smooth processing.
- Use scheduled transfers for recurring payments to maintain your target balance above $5,000.
- For unusually large or time-sensitive transfers, initiate earlier in the business day to reduce the risk of delays.

## Upgrading from Silver Saver
If you are moving up from Silver Saver:
- Confirm you can maintain at least $5,000 in Silver Plus Saver.
- Request an upgrade through your online banking or by contacting support. Your balances will begin earning at the Silver Plus Saver rates as soon as the upgrade is completed.

## How to Verify Your Current APY and Bonus
- In online banking, open the Silver Plus Saver account details to view:
  - Your current balance tier (below or above the tier 2 threshold)

1. Internal: Applying Credits and Rebates to Checking Accounts
   ID: doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_017
   Score: 19.4162
   Content: ## Overview

This document describes the policy and procedure for agents to apply credits to customer checking accounts. Credits may only be applied to checking accounts (not savings accounts or other account types). The apply_checking_account_credit_5829 tool is used to add a credit transaction to a checking account.

## Eligible Circumstances for Applying Credits

Agents are authorized to apply credits to checking accounts ONLY in the following circumstances:

### 1. Missing Rebates

If a rebate that should have been applied to the customer's account has not yet been applied, and the customer meets all eligibility requirements for that rebate, the agent may apply the credit. Before applying:
- Verify the customer is eligible for the rebate based on documented rebate policies
- Confirm the rebate has not already been applied by checking the account's transaction history
- Ensure the rebate amount matches what is specified in the applicable rebate policy

### 2. Fee mischarges

If any fees on the customer's account do not match the correct amounts per the documented fee schedule, the agent must identify all fee discrepancies and apply a credit for the net correction. Before applying:
- Review the account terms and documented fee structures to identify all fees that differ from what should have been charged
- Check the transaction history to confirm each fee discrepancy
- Ensure the credit amount reflects the net correction across all identified fee discrepancies

## Credit Types

When applying a credit, use the appropriate credit_type:
- `rebate_credit`: For rebates that should have been applied but were missing
- `fee_refund`: For refunding fees that were incorrectly charged

## Procedure

1. Verify the customer's identity and account ownership
2. Confirm the account is a checking account (credits cannot be applied to savings or other account types)
3. Verify the customer meets one of the eligible circumstances listed above
4. Calculate the correct credit amount based on the rebate policy or fee that was overcharged
5. Use the apply_checking_account_credit_5829 tool to apply the credit
6. Inform the customer of the applied credit and new account balance

## Agent Tool Usage (Internal Only)

- Tool: apply_checking_account_credit_5829(account_id, amount, credit_type)
  - When to call: After confirming the customer meets one of the eligible circumstances above
  - How to set parameters:
    - account_id: The checking account ID to credit
    - amount: The positive dollar amount to credit (must be greater than 0)
    - credit_type: Must be one of 'rebate_credit' or 'fee_refund'
  - Expected outcome: Adds a credit transaction to the checking account and updates the account balance

The apply_checking_account_credit_5829 tool may only be called ONCE per checking account per customer interaction. After a credit is applied to a checking account, the system enforces a 14-day cooldown period before another credit can be applied to that same account. Because only one credit call is allowed per account, if multiple corrections are needed for the same account (e.g., both fee refunds and missing rebates), combine them into a single credit with the total amount and use the credit_type that applies to the majority of the corrections.

## Important Restrictions

- Credits may ONLY be applied to checking accounts. Savings accounts and other account types are not eligible.
- Credits may only be applied for the two circumstances listed above. Do not apply credits for any other reason without supervisor approval.
- Always document the reason for the credit by selecting the appropriate credit_type. 
- The credit amount must match the exact rebate or fee amount - do not round or estimate.

2. (Internal) Applying a Credit Card Statement Credit
   ID: doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_017
   Score: 17.6806
   Content: ## Purpose

When an agent needs to apply a statement credit to a customer's credit card account (for goodwill adjustments, promotional credits, fee reversals, or other account credits), use the apply_statement_credit_8472 tool. First unlock the tool using unlock_discoverable_agent_tool, then call it using call_discoverable_agent_tool with the tool name and a JSON string containing all required arguments.

## Steps to Apply a Statement Credit

1. Unlock the tool:
   - Call unlock_discoverable_agent_tool with the tool name apply_statement_credit_8472.

2. Prepare the arguments JSON:
   - Include all required fields exactly as specified in Tool Arguments below.

3. Call the tool:
   - Use call_discoverable_agent_tool with:
     - Tool name: apply_statement_credit_8472
     - Arguments: JSON string containing user_id, credit_card_account_id, amount, and reason

4. Confirm the result:
   - Verify the credit appears as a negative transaction in the customer’s credit card transaction history and reduces the statement balance.

## Tool Arguments

1. user_id (string, required) - The customer's unique user identifier in the system.

2. credit_card_account_id (string, required) - The credit card account ID to apply the credit to. This can be found by calling get_credit_card_accounts_by_user.

3. amount (number, required) - The credit amount in dollars. Must be a positive number (e.g., 25.00 for a $25 credit).

4. reason (string, required) - The reason for the statement credit. Must be exactly one of:
   - 'goodwill_adjustment': One-time courtesy credit for customer satisfaction
   - 'promotional_credit': Credit from a promotional offer or campaign
   - 'annual_fee_reversal': Reversal of an annual fee charge
   - 'late_fee_reversal': Reversal of a late payment fee
   - 'interest_charge_reversal': Reversal of interest charges
   - 'dispute_resolution': Credit issued as part of dispute resolution
   - 'price_match': Credit for a price match guarantee
   - 'retention_offer': Credit offered to retain a customer
   - 'error_correction': Credit to correct a billing error
   - 'other': Other reasons not covered above

3. Internal: Applying Credits to Savings Accounts
   ID: doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_043
   Score: 17.6199
   Content: This document describes the policy and procedure for agents to apply credits to customer savings accounts. Use the apply_savings_account_credit_6831 tool to add a credit transaction to a savings account.

Eligible Circumstances for Applying Credits:

Agents are authorized to apply credits to savings accounts ONLY in the following circumstances:

1. Interest Corrections: If a customer's interest payment was calculated incorrectly due to a system error (e.g., missing APY boost from linked checking account, incorrect tier rate applied, missing relationship bonus), the agent may apply a credit to correct the discrepancy. Before applying: Verify the customer's account details and APY components using get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847, review transaction history using get_bank_account_transactions_9173 to confirm the interest amount credited, calculate the correct interest amount based on documented APY rates and bonuses, determine the difference between expected and actual interest.

2. Fee Refunds: If a fee was incorrectly charged to the savings account (e.g., excess withdrawal fee charged when customer was within limits, monthly maintenance fee charged when balance requirement was met), the agent may apply a credit to refund the incorrect fee.

3. Goodwill Credits: In exceptional circumstances where a customer has experienced significant inconvenience due to bank error, a goodwill credit may be applied. Goodwill credits should be rare and typically require supervisor approval for amounts over $25.

Tool: apply_savings_account_credit_6831
Parameters:
- account_id (string): The savings account ID to credit
- amount (number): The positive dollar amount to credit (must be greater than 0)
- credit_type (string): Must be one of 'interest_correction', 'fee_refund', or 'goodwill_credit'

Procedure:
1) Verify the customer's identity and account ownership
2) Confirm the account is a savings account
3) Verify the customer meets one of the eligible circumstances listed above
4) Calculate the correct credit amount based on the discrepancy or fee
5) Use apply_savings_account_credit_6831 to apply the credit
6) Inform the customer of the applied credit and new account balance

For interest corrections, after applying the credit, you should also submit an interest discrepancy report using submit_interest_discrepancy_report_7294 to ensure the backend team investigates and fixes the underlying issue.

4. Internal: Opening Business Savings Accounts
   ID: doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_004
   Score: 16.3726
   Content: ## Description

Procedure for opening business savings accounts. Eligibility requirements: 1) Customer must be verified, 2) Customer must already have at least one business checking account with status OPEN, 3) Customer cannot have more than 4 business savings accounts, 4) Customer must not have any accounts with negative balances, 5) Existing business checking account must have been open for at least 30 days, 6) Existing business checking account must have a balance of at least $2,500. Steps: 1) Verify customer identity, 2) Check eligibility requirements, 3) Confirm account selection with customer (business savings account_class options include Bronze Saver Account, Silver Saver Account, etc.), 4) Use open_bank_account_4821 to open the account, 5) Ask the customer if they would like you to transfer the opening deposit from their business checking account now. If yes, use transfer_funds_between_bank_accounts_7291 to transfer the required amount. If no, inform them they have 30 days to fund the account (via internal transfer or external deposit) or the account will be closed.

## Eligibility Requirements

Confirm all of the following before proceeding:
- Customer identity is verified.
- Customer has at least one business checking account with status OPEN.
- Customer has fewer than 4 existing business savings accounts.
- Customer has no accounts with negative balances.
- At least one existing business checking account has been open for at least 30 days.
- That business checking account has a current balance of at least $2,500.

Notes:

   Content: ## Purpose

This document outlines the step-by-step workflow for agents to process CLI requests, including verification and final decision. These steps MUST be followed in the exact order listed.

## Step 0: Confirm Requested Amount is Within Limits

BEFORE submitting any CLI request, verify that the customer's requested increase amount is within the maximum allowed for their card tier. If the requested amount exceeds the limit, inform the customer of the maximum allowed and ask them to adjust their request. Do NOT submit a request that exceeds the tier limit.

## Step 1: Submit the CLI Request

Once the customer has confirmed a valid increase amount within their tier's limits, submit the request on their behalf using the submit_credit_limit_increase_request_7392 tool. This creates a formal record of the request before eligibility checks are performed. Eligibility checks are internal and not exposed to customers, so the submission must happen first.

### Tool Arguments: submit_credit_limit_increase_request_7392

- credit_card_account_id (string, required): The credit card account ID.
- user_id (string, required): The customer's unique identifier.
- requested_increase_amount (integer, required): The dollar amount by which to increase the credit limit (e.g., 1000 for a $1,000 increase).

## Step 2: Verify Basic Eligibility

After submitting the request, verify the customer meets all eligibility requirements. You MUST check ALL of the following eligibility criteria before making an approval or denial decision as this ensures complete audit records.

1. Account Age: Verify the account has been open for the minimum required days for their card tier.
2. Cooldown Period: Use the get_credit_limit_increase_history_4829 tool to check if the customer has submitted a request within the cooldown period for their card tier. If a request exists within this period, deny the new request and inform the customer when they will be eligible to submit again.
3. No Pending Disputes: Verify the account has no active disputes.
4. No Pending Replacement Cards: Verify there are no outstanding replacement card orders for this account. If a replacement is pending, the CLI cannot be processed until the replacement is delivered or cancelled.
5. Account Good Standing: The account must be current with no past-due balance.
6. Credit Utilization: Verify current utilization is below the maximum threshold for their card tier.

### Tool Arguments: get_credit_limit_increase_history_4829

- credit_card_account_id (string, required): The credit card account ID to check.

## Step 3: Verify Payment History and Requested Amount

.

## Step 4: Process the Decision

If all requirements are met and the requested amount is within limits:

1. Use the approve_credit_limit_increase_5847 tool to approve and apply the increase.

### Tool Arguments: approve_credit_limit_increase_5847

- credit_card_account_id (string, required): The credit card account ID.
- user_id (string, required): The customer's unique identifier.
- new_credit_limit (float, required): The new total credit limit to set.

If any requirements are not met:

1. Use the deny_credit_limit_increase_5848 tool to record the denial.

### Tool Arguments: deny_credit_limit_increase_5848

- credit_card_account_id (string, required): The credit card account ID.
- user_id (string, required): The customer's unique identifier.
- denial_reason (string, required): Must be one of: 'insufficient_account_age', 'cooldown_period_active', 'pending_disputes', 'pending_replacement_card', 'past_due_balance', 'high_utilization', 'insufficient_payment_history', 'requested_amount_exceeds_limit', 'other'.

## Step 5: Communicate the Decision

Inform the customer of the decision and provide next steps. For approvals, confirm the new credit limit. For denials, explain the reason and when they may be eligible to reapply.

## Eligibility Requirements (Internal Checklist)

- Authenticate the customer and confirm identity verification status on file.

2) Check eligibility

3) Confirm account selection

4) Open the savings account (agent action)

    - destination_account_id: the newly opened personal savings account to be credited.

  - Expected outcome: Moves funds from checking to savings to complete the opening deposit.

- Exceeds savings account limit: If the customer already has 5 personal savings accounts, do not open a new one. Inform the customer they have reached the maximum.
- Insufficient checking tenure: If the checking account has been open fewer than 14 days, advise the customer when they will become eligible.

3. Internal: Checking Account Referral Program Terms and Restrictions
   ID: doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_047
   Score: 16.1966
   Content: ## Program overview
Each checking account type has its own referral bonus amounts and qualification requirements. This document covers the general terms and restrictions that apply to all checking account referral programs. Before giving any recommendations or information on referral terms, you must check that the user is eligible to submit referrals first, as users who are not eligible to submit referrals while being given recommendations by the agent tend to leave dissatisfactory reviews. 

## Rolling window limit
- You can receive at most 2 referral bonuses in any rolling 9-day window.
- If you attempt to receive more than 2 referrals in a single 9-day period, the third referral (and any subsequent referrals in that window) will be automatically denied.
- This limit applies across all checking account types; referrals from different accounts count toward the same 9-day cap.
- A rolling 9-day window means the count is evaluated based on the exact timestamps of your most recent referral bonuses, not calendar weeks.
- Auto-denied referrals due to the limit cannot be reinstated within the same 9-day window.

## Eligibility restrictions
- The referred person must be a new Rho-Bank customer with no existing checking, savings, or closed accounts within the past 12 months.
- The referrer and referred person cannot be registered at the same address.
- The referred person must be 18 years or older, except for the Light Green Account which allows minors with a guardian.
- For business accounts: The referred business must have a different primary owner than any existing Rho-Bank business account, based on the SSN of the primary authorized signer.

## Referrer tenure policy
- Every referral program requires the referrer to meet a tenure threshold before participating.
- This threshold is calculated from when you first became a Rho-Bank checking customer—specifically, the date your earliest checking account was opened.
- The type of account you currently hold is irrelevant to this calculation. Whether you have a basic or premium product, the tenure measurement remains the same.
- Consequently, holding one account type does not prevent you from referring someone to a different account type, as long as the duration since your first account meets or exceeds the program's stated minimum.

## Bonus conditions
- The qualifying deposit must be new money and cannot be transferred from another Rho-Bank account.
- The qualifying deposit must remain in the account for at least 30 days after the qualifying period ends.
- If the referred account is closed within 90 days of opening, the referral bonus may be reversed (clawback provision).

## Stacking restrictions
- The referral bonus cannot be combined with other new account promotions or sign-up bonuses.
- Only one referral code can be applied per new account.

## Referral status definitions
- COMPLETE — The referred person has successfully opened a new account and met the criteria to receive the referral bonus.
- IN_PROGRESS — The referred person has successfully opened a new account and is working toward meeting the qualifying deposit requirement.
- NO_PROGRESS — The referred person has not applied yet; no progress has been made.
- APPLIED — The referred person has submitted an application and is awaiting a decision.
- REJECTED — The referral has been denied (e.g., rolling window limit exceeded, ineligible referral).
- ERROR — A system error occurred during the referral process.

## Practical guidance
- Track the timing of your last two successful referral bonuses before sending additional referrals.
- If a referral is denied for hitting the rolling window limit, wait until enough time has passed to drop under the cap before attempting another.
- Both accounts must remain in good standing for bonuses to be paid.
